overall_notes: The paper focuses on non-collaborative dialogue generation with strategy planning. It uses both automatic metrics (Success Rate, Average Turn, SL%, ΔH) and human evaluation. LLMs are used as generators but not as evaluators. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of dataset names and metric variants.
